Product Description

Eevee & Friends Light Up with Stellar Colors! From fluffy and fiery to freezing and fanciful, Eevee and its many Evolutions hold a special place in the hearts of Pokémon Trainers across the land! Discover their unique new powers as Stellar Tera Pokémon ex, and look for treasure of your very own across a grand gathering of Pokémon ex from Paldea and beyond. Glittering gems and hidden patterns await at the end of the rainbow in the Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Prismatic Evolutions expansion.

WARNING:

CHOKING HAZARD -- Small parts. Not for children under 3 yrs.

    Important information

    Directions

    1. Open the booster bundle packaging. 2. Remove one of the six booster packs. 3. Carefully open the booster pack by tearing along the perforations. 4. Remove the 10 Pokémon cards from the booster pack. 5. Shuffle the cards to create your deck. 6. Follow the rules of the Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet game to play and enjoy your new cards.

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    • UlcerBoy
      5 out of 5 stars
      Nostalgic and great card quality!!
      Reviewed in the United States on December 9, 2025
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I was a huge Pokémon card collector as a kid — along with a bunch of other trading card games. Unfortunately, my entire collection was given away without my knowledge, and that kind of broke my heart. I stopped collecting for years after that loss.

      Now at 25, I’m slowly getting back into collecting — mostly for the art rather than the gameplay. I bought this booster bundle and I’m really happy with it! Everything was sealed properly, no fakes, and the card quality was excellent: no bent corners, no creases, nice and clean. I even pulled a few good ones! Nothing extremely rare, but definitely some beautiful art cards and a handful of fun holos.

      The price is a bit higher than I expected, but honestly still worth it for the nostalgia and excitement of opening packs again. I’m glad this was part of my return to collecting.

    • The Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Prismatic Evolutions Booster Bundle contains six booster packs from Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Prismatic Evolutions.
    • A great way to get multiple booster packs without getting having to buy packs individually or having to get a full booster box.
    • A great gift for any Pokemon collector or player.

    Product Description

    Eevee & Friends Light Up with Stellar Colors! From fluffy and fiery to freezing and fanciful, Eevee and its many Evolutions hold a special place in the hearts of Pokémon Trainers across the land! Discover their unique new powers as Stellar Tera Pokémon ex, and look for treasure of your very own across a grand gathering of Pokémon ex from Paldea and beyond. Glittering gems and hidden patterns await at the end of the rainbow in the Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Prismatic Evolutions expansion.

    Important Information

    Directions

    1. Open the booster bundle packaging. 2. Remove one of the six booster packs. 3. Carefully open the booster pack by tearing along the perforations. 4. Remove the 10 Pokémon cards from the booster pack. 5. Shuffle the cards to create your deck. 6. Follow the rules of the Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet game to play and enjoy your new cards.
